meta.notes: KES Shroff is an autonomous college (affiliated to University of Mumbai) and does NOT publish its syllabus/unit contents on kessc.edu.in (course pages, NEP page, WP media library and notices were all checked). Subject names and codes per semester are therefore taken from official KES exam time-tables and result sheets linked from https://kessc.edu.in/notices/ (Google Drive PDFs) and marked source.type='kes_official'. Unit topics for each subject come from a published syllabus of the same/closest-named subject elsewhere and are marked per subject in topics_source (mumbai_university_fallback = MU NEP syllabus re-hosted by MU-affiliated colleges since mu.ac.in PDF links return 404; other_fallback = SNDT or other university). Sem I/III/V lists are the 2026-27 syllabus (26U codes); Sem II/IV/VI lists are from Mar/Jun 2026 exams (23U/24U/25U codes). Languages, EVS, IKS, Indian Constitution, OJT and co-curricular papers are omitted; communication papers are listed under soft_skills. IKS-for-Computing and IPR/Cyber-law papers are kept as they are department papers.
